status: analysis exploration lock; not a model; no version assigned

quinella: top2MarginalCorrectedPairP(alpha) * officialOdds^gamma for alpha in {0.5,1.0,1.5} and gamma in {0.75,1.0,1.25}
strict-OOS marginal-pair-v2 probability * officialOdds^gamma for gamma in {0.75,1.0,1.25}
wide: same fixed expert families as quinella, using top3 marginal signal and JRA wide lower-bound odds

expertOutcomeTargets.top1: actual JRA return multiplier of the expert's top ticket
expertOutcomeTargets.top9: mean actual JRA return multiplier of the expert's top nine distinct tickets

metaFeatures: win-model vs win-market entropy/concentration/KL and edge summaries
expert selected-ticket official-odds and official-market-rank summaries

metaModels.unit: bet type x target(top1 or top9)
metaModels.model: LightGBM Huber regression on log1p(actual expert return)

coldStartDominantType: required type whose chosen expert has the highest mean top-nine pre-race expected-return score in that race

portfolioConstruction.mandatory: 100 yen on top1 chosen expert ticket in each of win/wide/quinella
portfolioConstruction.remaining1700: choose the required bet type with highest predicted top9 expert return; increase its top1 ticket from 100 to 200 and put 200 yen on its next eight distinct expert-ranked tickets

raceSelection: compute predicted portfolio return from predicted chosen-expert top1/top9 returns, then select exactly the five highest predicted races per raceDate x venue; never fewer
